I can help, but first I need to authenticate you.

- If they’re in **different delivered orders**, we may be able to do both (one action per order).

To figure out **which saves you more money**, I’ll need the **order id(s)** and the **payment method** you want the refund to use.  
**Please send the order ID for the water bottle and the order ID for the pet bed/office chair** (they can be the same or different).
